ctx.x: Billy Bowen had gone ahead, because Billy had his car, you know.

So they carried us down there, and when we got in the courthouse, where the jail was and everything, I seen this little boy. I said, "Oh, man, this is ...(?)... that got the soda." So they brought us all in there, and we were sitting down, and the little boy come out and pointed at Gabby -- so Gabby was the only one they took away.
